title: Shangarh & Sainj Valley
reportingPoint: Majnu ka Tilla, Delhi (nearest metro station: Vidhan Sabha), departing in the evening; pickup from Chandigarh is also available. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.
highlights: Shangchul Mahadev, a revered wooden temple
Pundrik Rishi Lake trek through meadows
1 km hike to the Rupi Raila waterfall
Sainj market and Lakshmi Narayan Temple
overview:
A peaceful hamlet where wooden temples stand tall and meadows stretch endlessly: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** Shangarh and Sainj Valley group trip leaves Delhi in the evening in an AC vehicle, with pickup from Chandigarh too, and gets you back early on Day 4.

Day 1 reaches Shangarh (about 2,100 m) for Barshangarh waterfall, Shangchul Mahadev Temple and the Shangarh meadows, then a bonfire and dinner. Day 2 is a small, beautiful trek through meadows to Pundrik Rishi Lake. Day 3 has a 1 km hike to the Rupi Raila waterfalls, Sainj market and the Lakshmi Narayan Temple before leaving Aut by 7 PM. Two nights in a hotel or homestay, 4 meals, travel and a trip captain are included. Prices start at ₹7,000 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra), and you reserve with a ₹3,000 advance.

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi
itinerary.content:
Assemble at the pickup point, meet your team captain and the group, and depart in the evening in an AC vehicle.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).
Overnight journey.

itinerary.title: Shangarh exploration
itinerary.content:
Reach Shangarh by morning and check in at a homestay. Freshen up.
Visit Barshangarh waterfall and Shangchul Mahadev Temple.
Wander the famous Shangarh meadows.
Bonfire, dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pundrik Rishi Lake trek
itinerary.content:
Wake up to the morning view, freshen up and have breakfast.
Set off on a small, beautiful trek through meadows to Pundrik Rishi Lake.
Back to the stay for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Raila waterfall, Sainj and departure
itinerary.content:
Have breakfast and leave for Raila.
Hike 1 km to the Rupi Raila waterfalls, then visit Sainj market and the Lakshmi Narayan Temple.
Depart for Delhi from Aut by 7 PM. Reach early on Day 4.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: Pickup is from Delhi (Majnu ka Tilla; nearest metro station Vidhan Sabha) or Chandigarh, with departure in the evening in an AC vehicle and a dinner halt on the way (not included). Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip. You reach Shangarh by morning.

faqs.q: How much does the Shangarh and Sainj Valley trip cost?
faqs.a: On regular dates, ₹7,000 per person on quad sharing, ₹7,500 on triple sharing and ₹8,000 on double sharing. Christmas and New Year batches (departures from 24 to 30 December) cost ₹8,500 quad, ₹9,000 triple and ₹9,500 double. 5% GST is extra.

2 nights in a hotel or homestay, transfers in an AC vehicle, 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners, all sightseeing in the itinerary, a bonfire and music party, a trip captain, and extra mattresses for triple and quad sharing.
Day 2 is a small trek through meadows to Pundrik Rishi Lake, and Day 3 has a 1 km hike to the Rupi Raila waterfalls. Wear running or outdoor shoes.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Pay a ₹3,000 per person advance to reserve your seat, by UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking, and clear the balance 24 hours before boarding. By paying the advance you accept the terms and conditions. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances, and there are no refunds for inclusions you don't use. Bookings can't be transferred: only the names given at confirmation may travel.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Nights are cold, so pack a down jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, outdoor shoes and personal medication. The full list is under Things To Pack.
